evidence.detail: Date <th> is always rendered — no conditional to suppress it
Date <td> is always rendered — no hide_date conditional
tournament_decks dict passed to deck_tables has no hide_date key; all decks in the table share the same competition date
Only the clickable-row PR (8d98879d) touched deckrow since the issue; no date-column change

triage.fix_sketch: Option A (remove column): wrap the Date <th> in decktable.mustache and the date <td> in deckrow.mustache with {{^hide_date}}...{{/hide_date}}, then add 'hide_date': True to the tournament_decks dict in decksite/views/home.py:setup_decks(). Option B (move date to title): in home.py, fetch the tournament date from the first tournament_deck and append it to the 'Latest Tournament Top 8' title string. Either is ~5–10 lines.
triage.notes: Issue author suggests option B ('put it underneath') may be preferable UX; both options are small and safe.
